result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with one notable visual issue identified.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is being clipped/truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally truncated. The text cuts off abruptly at the card boundary.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and white-space: nowrap to restaurant name labels so truncation appears intentional, or ensure the card width accommodates the label properly.
